tagline: STIHL equipment and parts for Hawera locals
heroSubheading: We supply and service STIHL equipment for gardens, farms, and contractors
aboutHtml:
We're a STIHL shop in the heart of Hawera, run by Damon Milham. We stock a comprehensive range of STIHL equipment and genuine parts for anyone who needs reliable power tools. Whether it's for gardens, farms, or small contractors, we've got what you're looking for.

We sell STIHL equipment, service what we sell, supply replacement parts, and give honest advice about what'll work best for your needs. Whether you need a new tool, repairs for an existing one, or just some guidance, we'll make sure you get what's right for your job.

Come in and see us Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, or Saturday mornings from 6am. We're here to help you find the right gear and keep your STIHL running well.
